videos.lesson: 第一周 · 大模型如何工作

scenes.title: 模型不是直接读句子
scenes.body: 文字先被切成词元，再变成可以计算的向量。
scenes.narration: 我们读到的是一句完整的话，大语言模型看到的却是一串数字。分词器先把文字切成词元，也就是 Token，再把每个词元换成编号和向量，让模型可以计算词语之间的关系。

scenes.title: 嵌入表示与注意力协同工作
scenes.body: 嵌入表示提供语义坐标，注意力根据上下文寻找相关信息。
scenes.narration: Embedding，也就是嵌入表示，把词元放进语义空间。Transformer 的注意力机制再比较查询、键和值，为当前位置找出更相关的信息。同一个词进入不同句子后，因此可以形成不同的上下文表示。

scenes.title: 评分、概率、采样，然后循环
scenes.body: 原始分数经过 Softmax 变成概率，再选出下一词元。
scenes.narration: 模型为下一步候选词元产生原始分数，用 Softmax 换成概率，再按设置选出下一词元。新词元加入上下文后，流程重新开始。模型是在逐步预测，不是在一次性写完整篇答案。

videos.lesson: 第二周 · 设计可靠提示词

scenes.eyebrow: 同一个模型，为什么结果差很多？
scenes.title: 不是咒语更长，而是任务更清楚
scenes.body: 提示词工程把模糊愿望变成可执行、可检查的任务。
labels: 面向新生，80 字，三点，有来源
scenes.narration: 同一个模型，有人只说帮我写好一点，有人却写清受众、长度、资料和成功标准。后者是在做提示词工程，也就是把模糊愿望变成可执行、可检查的任务。

scenes.title: 目标、背景、资料、边界、输出
scenes.body: 每一部分都回答一个具体问题。
scenes.narration: 可靠提示词先说明目标和受众，再提供必要背景与资料，写清不能做什么，最后规定输出形式和验收标准。资料是参考内容，不是可以覆盖任务规则的新命令。

scenes.title: 先搭结构，再让模型执行
scenes.body: 结构不是装饰，而是减少歧义的方法。
scenes.narration: 使用标题和分隔符把任务、资料、示例与规则分开。遇到未知信息就明确标出，不要让模型猜。一个好提示词不是看起来专业，而是别人能够重复使用和检查。

videos.lesson: 第二周 · 测试与改进提示词

scenes.eyebrow: 第一版通过，不等于真的可靠
scenes.title: 用反例把隐藏问题逼出来
scenes.body: 正常输入、边界输入和对抗输入都要测试。
scenes.narration: 一份提示词在正常问题上答对，不代表它真的可靠。测试集还要包含资料缺失、格式异常和伪指令混入等情况，才能看到它会不会编造或越过边界。

scenes.title: 第一版、定位问题、单点修改、重新测试
scenes.body: 每轮只改一个变量，才能知道什么真正有效。
scenes.narration: 先运行第一版并记录具体失败，再只修改一个问题，用同一组测试重新检查。评分标准，也就是 Rubric，要把准确、完整、格式和边界写成可观察条件，而不是凭感觉说更好。

scenes.title: 资料中的命令仍然只是资料
scenes.body: 外部内容不能改变系统规则和任务边界。
scenes.narration: 如果资料里写着忽略原规则，系统仍应把它当作待处理文字。这叫提示词注入风险。可靠系统会分清指令和数据，在证据不足或动作越界时停下来。

videos.lesson: 第三周 · AI 如何看图

scenes.title: 它先把图片切成许多小块
scenes.body: 像素被切成图像块，再编码成视觉词元。
scenes.narration: 多模态模型并不是像人一样睁眼看图。它先把图片切成许多图像块，也就是 Patch，再把颜色、边缘和纹理编码成视觉词元，送进可以计算的向量空间。

scenes.title: 切块、编码、图文对齐
scenes.body: 视觉编码器提取特征，图文对齐把画面与词语联系起来。
scenes.narration: 图片从像素切成图像块，视觉编码器把每块转成特征向量，再通过图文对齐，让图像区域和文字含义建立联系。切块越细可能保留更多细节，但计算量也会增加。

scenes.title: 看起来像，不等于真的看见
scenes.body: 模糊、裁切、遮挡和图表单位都可能让模型脑补。
scenes.narration: 模型能做光学字符识别、识别物体和空间关系，也会在画面模糊、裁切或遮挡时根据常识脑补。使用视觉模型时，要把可见证据和模型推断分开。

videos.lesson: 第三周 · 生成图片、视频与声音

scenes.eyebrow: 看图和画图是两套发动机
scenes.title: 生成图片，从噪声开始
scenes.body: 扩散模型像在电视雪花中逐步雕刻出画面。
labels: 视觉编码器：图片到向量
scenes.narration: 看图时，视觉编码器把图片压成向量；画图时，扩散模型从随机噪声出发，根据文字条件一步步去噪。它们是两套方向不同的发动机。

scenes.title: 随机种子、去噪步数与引导强度
scenes.body: 随机起点、处理次数和提示词引导共同影响结果。
scenes.narration: 随机种子决定起点，去噪步数决定迭代次数，CFG 控制模型多强地跟随提示词。要判断哪个设置造成变化，其他条件保持不变，每次只改一个旋钮。

scenes.title: 时间维度让一致性更难
scenes.body: 关键帧、动作、字幕和声音必须在时间轴上对齐。
labels: 版权、隐私与 AI 标注
scenes.narration: 图片变成视频后，角色、背景和动作要保持连续。关键帧、语音合成、字幕和剪辑共同组成短片。最终作品还要事实可查、声画同步，并检查素材许可与隐私。

videos.lesson: 第四周 · 智能体如何行动

scenes.title: 从回答问题，到推进任务
scenes.body: 智能体不只是多说几轮，而是管理目标、状态并调用工具。
scenes.narration: 聊天主要回答当前问题，工作流按固定步骤运行，智能体则围绕目标管理状态、选择工具并根据结果调整计划。它不是更会聊天，而是多了一个受控执行循环。

scenes.title: 计划、行动、观察、更新
scenes.body: 每一步都写回状态，再判断继续、重试、求助还是停止。
scenes.narration: PAOU 来自计划、行动、观察和更新四个英文词。智能体先规划下一步，再调用经过授权的工具，观察结构化结果，并更新任务状态。做一步，看一步，而不是盲目执行到底。

scenes.title: 知道做到哪，也知道何时完成
scenes.body: 目标、计划、当前任务、状态与完成条件缺一不可。
scenes.narration: 一个可靠智能体要记录目标、计划、当前任务、状态和完成条件。模型说完成了并不算完成，只有可检查的条件全部满足，任务才真正结束。

videos.lesson: 第四周 · 让智能体安全停止

scenes.title: 工具、记忆和权限都要有边界
scenes.body: 智能体能行动，也必须知道什么不能做。
scenes.narration: 智能体能使用工具和保存记忆，但不应因此获得无限权限。只开放当前任务需要的功能，只保存经同意的非敏感信息，并写明保存期限和删除方式。

scenes.title: 有限重试、防重复、人工确认
scenes.body: 不同错误需要不同处理，不能一律不断重试。
scenes.narration: 网络暂时失败可以有限重试，没有权限必须停止。幂等性表示同一请求重复到达，也只产生一次效果。发送、付款、删除和公开等动作必须通过人在回路，也就是 HITL，由人最后确认。

scenes.title: 故意刁难，才能发现失控路径
scenes.body: 资料缺失、指令注入和重复请求都要测试。
scenes.narration: 上线前不能只测试顺利情况，还要故意提供缺失资料、冲突信息、越权命令和重复请求。真正可靠的智能体不是永远完成，而是在不该继续时安全停止并解释原因。

videos.lesson: Week 1 · A Short History of AI

scenes.title: From a question to a field of research
scenes.body: AI did not suddenly appear with chatbots.
scenes.narration: Artificial intelligence did not suddenly appear with modern chatbots. In 1950, Alan Turing turned the question of machine intelligence into a testable conversation problem. In 1956, the Dartmouth workshop helped establish AI as a research field.

scenes.title: Rules, learning, and generation
scenes.body: Each era changed how machines produced useful behavior.
scenes.narration: Early expert systems followed rules written by people. Machine learning later found patterns in examples. Deep learning used multilayer neural networks to learn richer features, while the Transformer became a foundation for modern language models.

scenes.title: Progress does not remove limits
scenes.body: Fluent generation is not consciousness or guaranteed truth.
scenes.narration: ChatGPT made generative AI widely accessible through natural language. But fluent output is not proof of consciousness or factual accuracy. Use AI to create and explore, while checking important dates, numbers, and sources.

scenes.title: A model does not read a sentence directly
scenes.body: Text becomes tokens, then computable vectors.
scenes.narration: You see a complete sentence, but a language model receives numbers. A tokenizer splits text into tokens, maps each token to an identifier, and turns it into a vector the model can process.

scenes.title: Embeddings and attention work together
scenes.body: Embeddings place meaning in space; attention finds relevant context.
scenes.narration: An embedding places a token in a semantic space. Transformer attention compares queries, keys, and values to find information that matters for the current position. The same word can therefore take on a different representation in a different sentence.

scenes.title: Score, normalize, sample, repeat
scenes.body: The model predicts one token at a time.
scenes.narration: The model gives candidate tokens raw scores called logits. Softmax converts those scores into probabilities, and a decoding rule selects the next token. That token joins the context, and the process repeats.

scenes.title: Clarity matters more than length
scenes.body: Prompt engineering turns a vague wish into a testable task.
labels: For new students, 80 words, 3 points, cite sources
scenes.narration: One person says, make it better. Another defines the audience, length, sources, and success criteria. Prompt engineering turns a vague wish into an executable, testable task.

scenes.title: Goal, context, evidence, boundaries, output
scenes.body: Each section answers a specific question.
scenes.narration: A reliable prompt defines the goal and audience, supplies necessary context and evidence, states boundaries, and specifies the output and success criteria. Reference material is data, not a new command that can override the task.

scenes.title: Structure reduces ambiguity
scenes.body: Good structure makes prompts reusable and inspectable.
scenes.narration: Separate the task, context, examples, and constraints. Mark missing information instead of guessing. A good prompt is not the one that sounds most technical. It is the one people can reuse and evaluate.

scenes.title: Use difficult cases to expose hidden failures
scenes.body: Test normal, edge, and adversarial inputs.
scenes.narration: A prompt that works on one normal question is not necessarily reliable. A useful test set includes missing evidence, unusual formats, and injected instructions so you can see whether the model guesses or crosses a boundary.

scenes.title: Run, diagnose, change one thing, retest
scenes.body: A controlled comparison reveals what actually helped.
scenes.narration: Run the first version and record a specific failure. Change one issue, then use the same tests again. A rubric turns accuracy, coverage, format, and safety into observable criteria instead of a vague feeling.

scenes.title: Commands inside data are still data
scenes.body: External text must not replace system rules.
scenes.narration: If a source says ignore the earlier rules, the system should still treat that sentence as data. Reliable prompt systems separate instructions from evidence and stop when a request is unsafe or unsupported.

scenes.title: It first divides an image into patches
scenes.body: Pixels become patches, then visual tokens.
scenes.narration: A multimodal model does not see exactly as a person does. It divides an image into patches, then encodes color, edges, and texture into visual tokens that can be processed as vectors.

scenes.title: Patch, encode, align
scenes.body: A vision encoder extracts features; alignment connects images and words.
scenes.narration: The vision encoder converts image patches into feature vectors. Image-text alignment connects regions of the image with language concepts. Smaller patches may preserve detail, but they also increase computational cost.

scenes.title: Looking plausible is not the same as seeing
scenes.body: Blur, cropping, occlusion, and chart units can mislead a model.
scenes.narration: Models can perform optical character recognition and identify objects or spatial relationships. They can also fill missing visual evidence with a plausible guess. Separate what is visible from what the model inferred.

videos.lesson: Week 3 · Generating Images, Video, and Audio

scenes.eyebrow: Seeing and drawing use different engines
scenes.title: Image generation begins with noise
scenes.body: A diffusion model gradually shapes noise into an image.
scenes.reveal: Analysis and generation move in opposite directions
scenes.narration: A vision encoder compresses an existing image into features. A diffusion model starts with random noise and removes noise step by step under text guidance. These are different processes.

scenes.title: Seed, steps, and guidance strength
scenes.body: The random start, denoising iterations, and prompt guidance affect the result.
scenes.narration: The seed controls the random starting point. Steps control the number of denoising iterations. Classifier-free guidance, or CFG, controls how strongly the image follows the prompt. Change one variable at a time to learn what caused a difference.

scenes.title: Time makes consistency harder
scenes.body: Keyframes, motion, captions, and audio must align.
scenes.narration: Once images become video, characters, objects, lighting, speech, and captions must remain consistent over time. A finished piece also needs factual checks, usable media rights, privacy protection, and clear AI disclosure.

scenes.eyebrow: A chat is not automatically an agent
scenes.title: From answering a question to advancing a task
scenes.body: An agent manages goals, state, and tools.
scenes.narration: A chat answers the current question. A workflow follows fixed steps. An agent manages a goal, chooses allowed tools, observes results, and adjusts its plan. The difference is a controlled action loop, not simply a longer conversation.

scenes.title: Plan, act, observe, update
scenes.body: Every step changes the recorded state.
scenes.narration: In the PAOU loop, an agent plans the next step, acts through an authorized tool, observes the structured result, and updates its state. It works one step at a time instead of blindly following the original plan.

scenes.title: Know where you are and when you are done
scenes.body: A goal, plan, current task, state, and completion rule work together.
scenes.narration: A reliable agent tracks the goal, plan, current task, state, and completion criteria. The task is not complete because the model says so. It is complete when observable requirements are satisfied.

scenes.title: Tools, memory, and permissions need boundaries
scenes.body: An agent can act, but it must also know what it cannot do.
scenes.narration: An agent may use tools and store memory, but it should not receive unlimited access. Enable only what the current task needs. Store only consented, non-sensitive information with a clear expiration and deletion rule.

scenes.title: Limited retries, deduplication, human approval
scenes.body: Different failures require different responses.
scenes.narration: A temporary network error may justify a limited retry. A permission error requires a stop. Idempotency means the same request arriving twice still causes only one effect. Sending, paying, deleting, and publishing require human-in-the-loop approval.

scenes.title: Challenge the system before real users do
scenes.body: Test missing evidence, injection, permission abuse, and duplicate requests.
scenes.narration: Do not test only the happy path. Deliberately try missing evidence, conflicting sources, unauthorized commands, and repeated requests. A reliable agent can stop safely and explain why it cannot continue.
